purpose: Fixture binding notes only; this is not an application file format or a JSON schema.
record_status: Illustrative template, not an importable drawing. Replace entire placeholder values with writer-owned typed values.

logical_ids.source_a: The plate source record; one owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.source_b: The block source record; distinct from source_a and reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.sheet_a: The plate sheet; distinct owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.sheet_b: The block sheet; distinct owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.

writer_owned.format: The assigned solidcraft-drawing/N format and pending-change policy; never mint N here.
writer_owned.writer_format_pending: Use the actual type/value supplied by the Drawing writer, not this placeholder string.
writer_owned.fixed_mm_encoding: Fixed millimetres in the agreed Drawing units encoding.
writer_owned.paper_encoding: Any one supported paper size/orientation, held fixed across both sheets/states.
writer_owned.border_profile_encoding: A copy of the supported border profile; do not assume an ID-only link.
writer_owned.plate_root_documents_encoding: The agreed documents value referring by ID to source_a and the plate root component.
writer_owned.block_root_documents_encoding: The agreed documents value referring by ID to source_b and the block root component.

source_root_component: Existing native fixture documents use root component 0. Bind that identity through the agreed Drawing representation; do not guess a new globally unique ID or rewrite the source.
not_decided_here: Printed revision versus protected repository tag
